uplink.description: Status report: 3.6 V, input0 pulse count 100, input1 pulse count 150
uplink._note: TTN example status report (netvox r718h2 codec yaml, Apache-2.0). Upstream oracle: Volt 3.6, PulseCount1 100, PulseCount2 150. byte3 0x24 -> 3.6 V; bytes[4..5]=0x0064=100 -> input0 pulse.count; bytes[6..7]=0x0096=150 -> input1 pulse.count. Each input terminal's count is a channels[] entry; battery stays top-level. Satisfies analog-interface.

uplink.description: Both inputs counting, input1 at 16-bit full scale: 3.6 V, input0 1234, input1 65535
uplink._note: Synthetic two-input frame in the TTN status-report shape (device id 0x3F), with distinct per-input counts so the entries cannot be transposed unnoticed and the counter's unsigned 16-bit ceiling is exercised. Upstream oracle semantics: PulseCount1 = bytes[4..5] = 0x04D2 = 1234 -> input0; PulseCount2 = bytes[6..7] = 0xFFFF = 65535 -> input1 (roll-over boundary, not a sentinel).
